Volume rendering of CT - PYCAD - Your Medical Imaging Partner
Mar 31, 2025Volume rendering of CT paints every voxel in a scan — not just a surface — so you can see vessels, bone, and soft tissue in one 3D view. The useful knobs are MIP vs DVR, transfer functions, and (when you want film lighting) cinematic rendering.
